The Outbrain Amplify API enables advertisers, agencies, and technology partners to integrate Amplify campaign management and reporting into their own tools and platforms. The API is organized around core entities: Marketer (a customer account), Campaign (a collection of promoted links), PromotedLink (a single piece of promoted content), Budget, AudienceTargeting, and PerformanceBy* analytics resources for retrieving performance metrics.
